nodes.Name: MapFS
nodes.DocComment:
A MapFS is a simple in-memory file system for use in tests,
represented as a map from path names (arguments to Open)
to information about the files, directories, or symbolic links they represent.

The map need not include parent directories for files contained
in the map; those will be synthesized if needed.
But a directory can still be included by setting the [MapFile.Mode]'s [fs.ModeDir] bit;
this may be necessary for detailed control over the directory's [fs.FileInfo]
or to create an empty directory.

File system operations read directly from the map,
so that the file system can be changed by editing the map as needed.
An implication is that file system operations must not run concurrently
with changes to the map, which would be a race.
Another implication is that opening or reading a directory requires
iterating over the entire map, so a MapFS should typically be used with not more
than a few hundred entries or directory reads.

nodes.Name: MapFile
nodes.DocComment: A MapFile describes a single file in a [MapFS].

nodes.Name: Open
nodes.DocComment: Open opens the named file after following any symbolic links.

nodes.Name: ReadLink
nodes.DocComment: ReadLink returns the destination of the named symbolic link.

nodes.Name: Lstat
nodes.DocComment:
Lstat returns a FileInfo describing the named file.
If the file is a symbolic link, the returned FileInfo describes the symbolic link.
Lstat makes no attempt to follow the link.

nodes.Name: fsOnly
nodes.DocComment:
fsOnly is a wrapper that hides all but the fs.FS methods,
to avoid an infinite recursion when implementing special
methods in terms of helpers that would use them.
(In general, implementing these methods using the package fs helpers
is redundant and unnecessary, but having the methods may make
MapFS exercise more code paths when used in tests.)

nodes.Name: mapFileInfo
nodes.DocComment: A mapFileInfo implements fs.FileInfo and fs.DirEntry for a given map file.

nodes.Name: openMapFile
nodes.DocComment: An openMapFile is a regular (non-directory) fs.File open for reading.

nodes.Name: mapDir
nodes.DocComment: A mapDir is a directory fs.File (so also an fs.ReadDirFile) open for reading.
